saw_lines: People rarely replace a whole pair of sunglasses, they swap the lenses when they scratch or want a new tint.
So the sale is won in the first line, where the buyer decides whether a swap beats buying new frames.
Your 6 of 13 copy ads open on the same upgrade line, so write new openers from the lens swap story and the fit guarantee, then test each against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 29 Oct 2026
points: 6 of your 13 copy ads open on the same “upgrade to SpectraBoost” line, so they compete with each other for the same buyers. Write new openers from the lens swap story and the fit guarantee, and test each against it.

Your site explains how lenses ship, yet 0 of 26 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a new buyer has no reason to click. Open ads for new buyers with the shipping answer, then say it in the replacement lens ads.
Your site shows lenses from $25 up to $129.00, yet 0 of 26 ads mention price, so buyers never see the saving. Lead one ad with lenses from $25 beside the price of a new pair.
One exact copy runs in 6 of your 13 copy ads, so the same buyer sees the same story again. Keep that copy, but change the opening line and the creative in each ad so every version reads as new.

ads_1: New openers on lens swaps and fit, tested against the SpectraBoost color hook
